## History

James A lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), and kept house with his sister until her death. Before she died, he promised her he would marry, and he subsequently wed [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott and took a wedding trip to St. John. The couple later separated after a dispute over his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), leading [Emily](../character/emily.md) to return to her own house while James eventually visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island).

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)_

**Volume 2**

- kept house with his sister until she died three years earlier  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>

- drowned at sea a month before his daughter was born  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--james-a.md)

James A and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are friendly neighbors who often talk and share food. Following the unexpected arrival of his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), James asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to come to his house so he can explain the backstory of their past separation.
